today.description:
Dear TruckersMP Community and Fellow Drivers,

We are immensely proud and thrilled to officially announce the **Wortex Group Company 1st Anniversary Convoy**! It has been an incredible year filled with miles of open roads, strong friendships, and a rapidly growing family.

To celebrate this major milestone in true trucking fashion, we have meticulously mapped out a magnificent long-haul route that promises an exceptional driving experience. For this grand celebration, we have reserved **44 dedicated slot areas** for our guest Virtual Trucking Companies (VTCs). We would be deeply honored to have you on the road with us on this special day!

---

![](https://i.imgur.com/xFySu4L.png)

> * Date : 17.11.2026 / Tuesday 
> * Meetup Time : 17:00 UTC- 20:00 TSİ
> * Departure   : 18:00 UTC - 21:00 TSİ
> * Server      : Event Server

---

![](https://i.imgur.com/clRIH7K.png)

> * Start Location : Hannover (Slot Areas / Companies)
> * Destination    : Mannheim (SteinBruch Company)

upcoming.description:
Greetings truckers!

This is the EventMK. We will hold a real operations event. This will be the biggest event we hold in a year of development

-----

# EventMK 1st Anniversary (Real Operations V1)
The event will take place on Wednesday, 18th November 2026 between 13:00 - 15:00 UTC. Our employees will work continuously for 2 hours

If you are not sure when you can play in your timezone, make sure to check our [Alternative Time Zones](https://notime.zone/OtAi6VrfJgHtM).


EventMK 1st Anniversary (Real Operations V1) will be held around x cities, including xxx, xxx or xxx
Scope: To be determined (photo)

During EventMK 1st Anniversary (Real Operations V1), you may choose any of the cities in the area of play above. You may also take a job from one city to another inside the area, or use your own trailer if you have one.


All participants are welcome to roam freely inside the highlighted area of play above to allow you to experience any route you may choose! Curious to check an operation again? You can always find a way to go back by safely turning around at a junction or even a roundabout!

-----

# **！！！ First Safety Reminder And Disclaimer ！！！**
Our content includes but is not limited to: Urgent transport, dynamic operations, Heavy cargo transport, and more!
There is a high probability of collisions occurring during the event. As long as this is not something you caused deliberately, we will choose to allow it to happen. Yielding can greatly reduce the likelihood of collisions.
Disclaimer: By attending this Real Operations event, you acknowledge that you may be involved in an incident happening right in front of you.

To ensure an organized, enjoyable, and safe monthly convoy for everyone, all participants are required to follow these rules:

📋 General Rules

1. Fully respect the scheduled meeting and departure time.
2. Arrive at the meeting point early enough before departure.
3. Follow the designated route and do not change the route without staff permission.
4. Reckless driving and random overtaking are not allowed.
5. Maintain a safe distance between trucks.
6. Intentional collisions or blocking other convoy members are strictly prohibited.
7. Follow the instructions of the Convoy Leader and Staff throughout the convoy.
8. Do not use horns or lights excessively or in a disturbing manner.
9. If you experience a technical problem, inform the staff and avoid stopping suddenly on the road.
10. Respect all participants and maintain good behavior.

* Minor violation: Warning.
* Repeated violation: Official warning.
* Serious or intentional violations may result in removal from the convoy or a ban from future events.
* Creating problems, provoking others, or disrupting the convoy is prohibited.

🏁 During the Convoy

* Maintain the convoy formation whenever possible.
* Do not overtake the Convoy Leader unless instructed by the staff.
* If you lose contact with the convoy, contact a staff member and wait for instructions.
* The purpose of the convoy is fun, organization, and teamwork.

We wish everyone a safe and enjoyable convoy. Following the rules is every participant’s responsibility. 🚛🤍
